Subject: Vendor enrollment — Redwood Inference (next steps)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance is ready to get Redwood set up as a vendor so we can start routing POs and pay invoices. I attached our AP requirements doc — a couple of specific items AP asked to confirm:

- PO reference: every invoice must include the Sentinel PO number in the invoice header and filename (PO-#####).
- Invoice format: PDF preferred, single invoice PDF per document; filename: Sentinel_PO-#####_Invoice_Redwood.pdf.
- Tax evidence: US vendors need W-9; EU vendors require VAT registration or self-cert.
- Payment terms: standard is Net 30 ACH for first production run; they asked whether Redwood can accept USD wire or ACH, and if Redwood supports remit-to bank tokenization for automated rails.
- Intercompany / netting: we sometimes run monthly netting for multi-entity customers — will Redwood accept a single netted payment and provide remittance detail per invoice?

Attachment: Sentinel_AP_Requirements_v1.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

Can you share the vendor tax docs, bank mandate, and a sample invoice that meets the PO/filename rules? If you have any platform or API endpoints for invoice acknowledgement, please let me know.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the requirements doc. Looping in Karthik (payments & pricing) and Marissa (onboarding) — they'll help get you the packet and sample files. A few quick clarifications so we send exactly what AP needs: 

1) Remittance/Netting: we can accept a single netted payment monthly provided Sentinel includes the remittance detail table (invoice id, amount, invoice date) in the payment advice. We also support per-invoice payments when requested.
2) Bank rails: we accept USD ACH and wire; we also support tokenized remit (payment token) for customers integrated via our portal.
3) PO matching: do you require 3-way match (PO + invoice + receipt) or 2-way (PO + invoice)? We typically require PO number and line-item descriptions for automated matching.
4) Tax form: we'll send a current W-9 and bank mandate. For VAT scenarios, Marissa will follow up with EU evidence format.

Karthik / Marissa — action items:
- Karthik: please attach Redwood_W9_2026.pdf and Redwood_Bank_Mandate.pdf and outline any special notes about netting and remittance format.
- Marissa: please include a sample invoice that follows Sentinel filename and shows the remittance detail table we can provide when netting is used.

We can also sign the DocuSign vendor form if that helps speed things — please send link.

Hi Liam — copying my response below and attaching the documents you requested.

Quick summary on the points Mina raised:

- Payment rails: USD ACH or USD wire both work. For tokenized remit we provide a payment token format and sample payload for your AP integration (let me know if you'd like the API spec).
- Netting: Redwood can accept a single monthly netted payment. We require the remittance advice to contain a CSV-style table (invoice_id, invoice_date, invoice_amount, currency) so we can auto-apply funds. If you need custom mapping, we can work with your payments team.
- PO matching: 2-way match (PO + invoice) is fine for services subscriptions; for hardware or one-time purchases we do 3-way where goods receipt is required. For your use-case (hosted inference service) 2-way match should be sufficient.
- Invoicing fields: invoice must include: Redwood legal name, Redwood tax ID, Sentinel PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line-item descriptions, currency, and bank remittance instructions (or token). Filename pattern as you listed is fine.

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf (PDF, 120KB); Redwood_Bank_Mandate.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8339 — feel free to add any AP contacts there so we can attach the final packet to the deal.

- Liam / Sentinel AP: send DocuSign vendor form link if you require an executed form.
